name: Lisha
source:
"Lisha", whose real name no human can pronounce successfully, is serious to a fault. She takes great pride in her conduct, heritage, grades, and every other aspect of her life. Lisha is also an extraordinary mage. 

Having lived for eons among her own kind, she possesses talent rarely found even among elves. The only thing Lisha seems to be incapable of is making friends.

She is an Elf and the daughter of Ein, the principal of Amadronia Magic Academy. She is a 1st year student in class 1-C of Amadronia Magic Academy.
